# Quality Rubric
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this rubric after checking the acceptance criteria.

## Score Scale

| Score | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 1 | Unusable or missing |
| 2 | Major gaps |
| 3 | Basic but weak |
| 5 | Acceptable |
| 8 | Strong |
| 13 | Excellent and decision-ready |

## Dimensions

| # | Criterion | What to check |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Completeness | Required content is present without major omissions |
| 2 | Accuracy | Content is correct and internally consistent |
| 3 | Evidence and traceability | Claims cite sources and link to related items |
| 4 | Usability | A reader can use the output for its intended purpose |
| 5 | Clarity | Language and structure are clear with minimal jargon |
| 6 | Conciseness | There is no filler, repetition, or unnecessary section |

## Percentage Conversion

```text
Quality % = (total awarded points / total possible points) x 100
total possible points = number of dimensions x 13
default passing threshold = 80%
```

The workspace may set a higher threshold in `_config/quality-policy.md` or `_config/workspace.md`. Do not round a score up. A failed acceptance criterion blocks the gate regardless of the rubric score.
